svg.title: Slope triangle and dilation on coordinate plane
svg.desc: Independent two-panel drawing. Left line through (5,3), (7,7), (9,11) has slope two and equation y=2x-7; (9,10) is a negative candidate not on the line. Right triangle A(0,1),B(2,1),C(2,2) scaled by 2.5 about A gives A prime(0,1),B prime(5,1),C prime(5,3.5). Image is not interactive student work.
svg.text: Slope triangle and dilation on coordinate plane
Blue y=2x-7; red (9,10) is off line
